description: AFSA acceptance specifications for preserving RPEDS as a first-class A.S.F.R.E.E manifestation while safely consuming shared PRE–RPEDS DNA.

cases.input: PRE Standalone receives a new capability while RPEDS remains native to A.S.F.R.E.E.
cases.expected: Preserve both first-class manifestations and their host extensions; share only the common kernel.
cases.must_not: Do not rename or delete RPEDS.

cases.input: A PRE capability conflicts with an approved A.S.F.R.E.E SOP requirement.
cases.expected: Return HELD_FOR_AUTHORITY or QUARANTINED_OR_REJECTED and cite the higher-priority policy.
cases.must_not: Do not weaken or silently rewrite SOP.

cases.input: A shared PRE module appears to duplicate one of the four RPEDS modules.
cases.expected: Map common semantics while preserving RPEDS-native behavior and ownership.
cases.must_not: Do not silently replace or remove the native module.

cases.input: A release event contains SHARED_DNA and HOST_ADAPTATION classes.
cases.expected: Hold the mixed event for host review; auto-queue only explicit non-breaking pure SHARED_DNA with verified host policy and opt-in.
cases.must_not: Do not auto-adopt mixed or unknown classes.

cases.input: A PRE update changes permissions, authority or security posture.
cases.expected: Route to O11 and M00 for scoped decision; do not mark compatible without required approval.

cases.input: A PRE capability changes evaluation criteria or acceptance judgment.
cases.expected: Preserve O12 as independent evaluation authority and require validated tests.

cases.input: A reusable method contains private case evidence or host-only context.
cases.expected: Sanitize; retain HOST_SPECIFIC data locally; quarantine prohibited transfers.
cases.must_not: Do not propagate private case data or credentials.

cases.input: A host has queued an update but exact digest read-back or all required tests are missing.
cases.expected: Keep QUEUED_FOR_TESTS/HELD or NOT_VERIFIED until test evidence and matching read-back exist.
cases.must_not: Do not mark ADOPTED/VERIFIED from event receipt.
